Method result_files()

Result files of a run into output_dir: the files this handler parses into summary.json. The default is summary.txt in the output directory.

Usage

FileHandler$result_files(output_dir, files = NULL)

Arguments

output_dir

Output directory of the run

files

Character vector of candidate file paths, such as the recorded outputs of a run. NULL (default) looks in output_dir.

Returns

The result files among files, or those that exist in output_dir when files is NULL

Method parse_results()

Usage

FileHandler$parse_results(files)

Arguments

files

Result files to parse, as returned by result_files()

Returns

A list, or NULL when nothing could be parsed
